# Shenwan Hongyuan (Hong Kong) Holdings Limited — 申万宏源(香港)

**Listed: HKEX 218.HK | Parent: Shenwan Hongyuan Group Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 000166, SEHK: 6806)**
**State-Owned Enterprise — Controlled by Central Huijin Investment Ltd. (China Investment Corporation)**
**Industry: Securities, Investment Banking, FICC Trading, Derivatives, Asset Management**
**Regulator: Securities and Futures Commission (SFC), Hong Kong — Types 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 9**
**Headquarters: Admiralty Centre, 18 Harcourt Road, Hong Kong**
**Offices: Hong Kong (Admiralty, Hennessy Rd, United Centre, PP3), Singapore, London, Tokyo, Seoul**
**Branches: Tsuen Wan, Shatin, Yuen Long**
**Website: swhyhk.com**
**Employees: 896**

---

## Summary

Shenwan Hongyuan (H.K.) Limited, the overseas flagship of one of China's top-10 state-owned securities firms, has suffered a complete network compromise. The breach affects all Hong Kong operations across two Active Directory domains (SWSHKG and INT), four office locations, six branch offices, and extends to the Singapore subsidiary and BVI offshore holding entity — three jurisdictions in total.

**21,002,068 files totaling 9.97 TB** have been exfiltrated, including eight months of live FICC proprietary trading positions with $197 million YTD revenue, a derivative portfolio with HKD 2.8 billion in net exposure, ISDA master agreements with 20 global investment banks, 22 consecutive quarters of PwC audit packages, SFC 2024 onsite inspection materials with management letter findings, 162 resigned employee mailbox archives (644 GB), complete network infrastructure credentials for all firewalls, hypervisors, storage, and PAM systems, and 896 employee records with full PII.

**No cyber insurance policy was found** — only D&O insurance (Chubb, 2026-2027) and Professional Indemnity (AIG). The full cost of this incident will be borne entirely by the company.

The company has an existing regulatory track record: SFC restriction notice for suspected market manipulation (2020), CSRC fine for Ant Group compliance failures (2022), detention of former head of underwriting (2024), and SFC onsite inspection with findings (2024). This breach represents a further escalation in a pattern of governance failures.

## Scope of Compromise

### Infrastructure — Total Network Takeover
- **2 Active Directory domains**: SWSHKG (swshkg.com.hk) and INT (int.swshkg.com.hk) — 1,091 computers
- **796 NTLM password hashes** from NTDS.dit, **509 plaintext credentials** from workstations
- **All network devices**: 6 firewalls (Palo Alto, Checkpoint, FortiGate), 5 F5 load balancers, 8 ESXi hypervisors, 5 SAN arrays (3PAR, Nimble, HP), 30+ managed switches across 4 offices
- **PAM system**: TPAM (PARAdmin/Admin4PAR) — **RSA Auth Manager** (2FA for VPN) — **PRTG** — **Kaspersky Admin** — all compromised
- **RedHat Satellite**: controls patching for ALL Linux servers
- **SQL SA production** (SunSystems ERP), **Veeam Backup** infrastructure, **Bomgar Remote Support**

### Email — 813+ GB Total
- **Mail Gateway Veeam backup**: 99.5 GB — full corporate Exchange email (July 2026)
- **162 resigned employee mailbox archives**: 644 GB — including **Roy Luo (MD FICC, 16.5 GB)**, WuYang (32.1 GB), JohnnyChan (23.8 GB), ChenXiEric (15.2 GB), AvisLAW (14.0 GB), HenryLau (13.8 GB), and 156 more
- Department mailboxes: CorporateFinanceHK, HelpDesk.Support, SWHY.Research
- **387,335 .msg files** across file shares (304 GB)

## Regulatory & Legal Exposure

The company holds **six types of SFC licenses** — the broadest possible scope for a Hong Kong securities firm. Under applicable regulations:

**Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (PDPO)**: Mandatory breach notification for 896+ employee records and unknown number of client records. The Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data (PCPD) has authority to investigate and impose compliance orders.

**Securities and Futures Ordinance (SFO)**: The compromised trading P&L data, position details, and derivative portfolio constitute market-sensitive information. Publication could trigger insider dealing investigations under SFO Part XIII.

**SFC Code of Conduct**: Licensed corporations must safeguard client assets and information. The 2024 inspection already identified compliance gaps — this breach demonstrates continued failure to maintain adequate cybersecurity controls.

**SFC Fit and Proper Requirements**: All licensed persons and responsible officers must be fit and proper. A breach of this magnitude, combined with the 2020 market manipulation freeze, 2022 CSRC fine, and 2024 executive detention, raises serious questions about the continued fitness of the company's management.

**Third-Party Notifications**: Each of the 20 ISDA counterparties, 32 bank facility providers, and all margin facility clients have contractual rights to be notified of material data breaches. Several ISDA agreements contain termination event clauses triggered by regulatory action or material adverse change.

**Parent Company Exposure**: Shenwan Hongyuan Group Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 000166, SEHK: 6806) is controlled by Central Huijin Investment Ltd. and subject to CSRC oversight. The breach of CPC party documents and internal governance materials creates additional political and regulatory exposure at the mainland level.

---

*21,002,068 files. 9.97 TB. Three jurisdictions. No cyber insurance. Data available for verification upon contact. Resolution discussions welcome prior to full publication and regulatory notification.*
